lines.text: There are two of me in this elevator. And he *killed* the last one.
lines.style: Young man, urgent and scared, fast and punchy, grabbing the listener immediately, the word killed hitting hard.

lines.text: You said ninety-nine. So I pressed it.
lines.style: Young man, tense and quick, talking straight to the viewer.

lines.text: I asked him what he did to the last Theo.
lines.style: Young man, low and shaking, afraid of the answer.

lines.text: He trusted me. I shut the doors on *him.*
lines.style: The same young man's voice but hoarse and exhausted, a flat broken confession, ashamed.
Young man, hushed, awe and fear, the last word wide-eyed.
Young man, horrified whisper, slow, the last word falling.

lines.text: Hundreds of us. All falling. All *trapped.*
lines.style: Young man, shaken and quick, voice rising with panic.

lines.text: You're early, Theo. Floor One had a *door.*
lines.style: Calm, polite, unsettling announcer voice over an old intercom, smiling too much, soft and slow, teasing.

lines.text: The chair was empty. The headset was still *warm.*
lines.style: Young man, tense whisper, creeping dread.

lines.text: Reset. This ends it. For *all* of them.
lines.style: The same young man's voice but hoarse and desperate, a dangerous hope, staring at something.

lines.text: Press it, and every Theo *dies.* Including you.
lines.style: Calm, polite, unsettling announcer voice over an old intercom, quietly delighted, very slow.

lines.text: Let him press it... or *stop* him?
lines.style: Young man, panicking, fast and desperate, torn between two choices.

lines.text: Comment *A* or *B.* You decide what I do.
lines.style: Young man, urgent and direct, speaking straight to the viewer, pleading but steady.

music.title: Floor 0 - Floor Ninety-Nine
music.style: Horror thriller score. Starts instantly at full intensity: pounding low drums, alarm-like strings and a rising siren tone. Then a tense rising pulse, a brief broken piano, a vast cold electronic drone with many ticking clocks, slowly building tremolo and heartbeat to a sudden cut. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under a voiceover.
